## 1.0.0 (2026-11-20)

### ✨ New Features

* add debug logging patch for network requests ([c78126c](https://github.com/saigauthamr/tao-patches/commit/c78126cfa5863c0a8902e8558cc2f26ef0001b3a))
* add favorites letter filter patch ([7e04cff](https://github.com/saigauthamr/tao-patches/commit/7e04cff745013c9ba1240cb732b206ab32cb7ea1))
* add network timeout patch and HTTP/2 frame logging ([f6b10d7](https://github.com/saigauthamr/tao-patches/commit/f6b10d757099a41ea93bf88416b71ad726717f07))
* add test build branding patch ([92645cd](https://github.com/saigauthamr/tao-patches/commit/92645cd2bfc8daf787788a00efb171cedf056517))
* cache API images on disk and share request hooks between patches ([5d003cc](https://github.com/saigauthamr/tao-patches/commit/5d003cc195b343f2bedfc75434dfbba74325cb3c))
* disable Firebase telemetry and remove ad tracking permissions ([40f66d1](https://github.com/saigauthamr/tao-patches/commit/40f66d167d2bd3f6ea2c8f876d73d37986b2ef26))
* merge identical in-flight API requests ([20d1b7c](https://github.com/saigauthamr/tao-patches/commit/20d1b7cb4a05a4a25ef664bf8e91acb007906e98))
* throttle repeated sync pulls ([be410fa](https://github.com/saigauthamr/tao-patches/commit/be410fae852dceae46783e16d536c2e294c27b02))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* merge requests with filter packets and never duplicate a slow leader ([3ee1139](https://github.com/saigauthamr/tao-patches/commit/3ee113971a7a25c996350d72a74152ee3502daf9))
* run favorites letter filter on every branch into the prefix read ([5165cf5](https://github.com/saigauthamr/tao-patches/commit/5165cf53011e36f06e276076e7a3d0a4aaa54b79))

patches.name: Cache images
patches.description: Keeps story covers and avatars on the device for 7 days instead of downloading them again every time they are shown. Images use the same one-at-a-time server queue as everything else, so this also makes stories and lists load sooner.

patches.name: Disable Firebase telemetry
patches.description: Stops Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Sessions from collecting and uploading data.

patches.name: Enable debug logging
patches.description: Logs network requests, request failures, HTTP/2 frames and the app's internal debug messages to logcat under the tag FFNTao. For troubleshooting only.

patches.name: Favorites letter filter
patches.description: Opens favorite stories filtered to one starting letter instead of all titles. Use this when the full favorites list fails to load. Other letters stay available in the A-Z bar.

options.description: Title letter the favorite stories list opens with, or # for titles starting with a non-letter.

patches.name: Merge duplicate requests
patches.description: Sends identical API requests that are in flight at the same time only once, and shares the response. The server answers one request at a time, so every duplicate removed makes the rest of the app respond sooner.

patches.name: Network timeout
patches.description: Changes the default API request timeout from 30 seconds. The server answers one request at a time, so a longer timeout also makes screens wait longer behind a slow request.

options.description: Seconds to wait for a server response. The app's default is 30.

patches.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches.description: Removes the advertising ID, ad attribution and install referrer permissions.

patches.name: Test build branding
patches.description: Renames the app and recolors its launcher icon so a patched install can be told apart from the official app installed alongside it.

options.description: Launcher name of the patched app.

patches.name: Throttle sync
patches.description: Skips pulling synced bookmarks, folders, history and offline stories from the server when the same sync already ran recently. Saves about six server requests on most app starts.

options.description: Minutes after a sync pull during which the same pull is skipped.
